parts.label: (c)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
Equate components of general points on their $l_1$ and $l_2$, provided both are line equations, and solve for $\lambda$ or $\mu$ - M1. Example: $(3+2\lambda,1+\lambda,-6+4\lambda)=(-1,3+\mu,-6+2\mu)$. Do not allow the same parameter for both lines if solving with two linear equations. Allow M1 for $3+2\lambda=-1\Rightarrow\lambda=\cdots$ even if other equations are incorrect or absent.

Obtain a correct parameter, e.g. $\lambda=-2$, $\mu=-4$ - A1. Allow M1A1 for $3+2\lambda=-1$ leading to $\lambda=-2$ even if other equations are incorrect or absent.

Obtain position vector $-\mathbf i-\mathbf j-14\mathbf k$ - A1, OE. Do not accept coordinates; allow even if the $\mathbf j,\mathbf k$ equations were incorrect or absent.
